message.content:
Tailored wool-blend blazer, structured shoulder cut, hip length in navy blue (#1B2951), fine weave.
Silk-trimmed blouse, relaxed collar, cropped at the waistline in ivory white (#FFFFF0), smooth satin finish.
Wide-leg trousers, tapered leg opening, ankle length in charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy crepe fabric.
Loafers, pointed toe, mid-calf height in matte black (#000000), soft leather material.
A small structured clutch, box shape in the same navy blue (#1B2951), smooth leather exterior with minimal hardware.

This outfit works because the tailored blazer and wide-leg trousers create a polished, professional silhouette that aligns with the smart dress code for the office. The neutral palette of charcoal, navy, and ivory keeps the look cohesive and sophisticated, while the relaxed blouse offers necessary comfort throughout the day. Crucially, the cropped waistline of the top and the high-waisted trousers visually elongate the torso, effectively drawing attention upward and away from the belly as requested.
